answer: An identity emits one pulse of judged work each epoch. The beacon pays that pulse only when it bears signatures from three distinct karst, each signer's residency earned by past work there, one signature per epoch — never bought, so fresh keys sign nothing. Each seal is paid in saffron, and the n-th seal one funding lineage buys per epoch costs n×base, burned: transfers trace to origin, so fresh wallets share the funder's counter. Its k clones therefore burn base×3k(3k+1)/2 saffron each epoch, honest seals repriced with them; self-funding clones must earn residency and seals by judged work.
